knowable_rule: a kept column the detector labels quasi_identifier (any subtype), or a kept non_sensitive column of subtype CATEGORY with at most 20 distinct values; sensitive attributes, dropped columns, keyed tokens and free text are never knowable

fitness.rule: Share of the released rows whose combination of every kept value (every kept column except keyed tokens and free text) is shared by fewer than 5 rows, on the final release after the k repair. Reported for the fit-for-sharing statement; it decides nothing in selection.
